_about: Seed content for the OpenWorker discovery demo. Non-PHI, fictional. Space=Davitademo, Jira=BP2. Contains a DELIBERATE CONTRADICTION (two incompatible no-show-rate definitions: PAGE glossary vs. dashboard spec) and a CLOSED SPIKE (BP2 spike, Won't Do) that recommends against the SMS-only approach the active epic assumes.

confluence_pages.title: Patient Transport No-Show Reduction — Program Charter
confluence_pages.body:
# Program Charter

**Problem.** Missed non-emergency medical transport (NEMT) trips at regional clinics waste capacity, delay care, and inflate cost per completed visit. Leadership has asked us to cut the transport no-show rate for regional clinics by 30% within two quarters.

**Scope.** Regional outpatient clinics using contracted NEMT and rideshare. Excludes inpatient discharge transport and emergency transport.

**Success metric.** Transport no-show rate (see Glossary). Target: from baseline to a 30% relative reduction.

**Sponsors.** VP Clinic Operations. **Product owner:** Regional Access squad.

**Key bets under consideration.** (1) Automated SMS reminders. (2) Live caller confirmation. (3) Rideshare fallback for same-day gaps. Each has an evaluation below; note the pilots and the closed spike before committing.

confluence_pages.title: Glossary — Transport Metrics (authoritative definitions)
confluence_pages.body:
# Transport Metrics Glossary

These are the **authoritative** metric definitions for the program. Report against these.

**Transport no-show rate.** Of all *scheduled* transport trips in a period, the share where the patient did not board and did **not** cancel at least 2 hours ahead.

`no_show_rate = no_shows / scheduled_trips`

- Same-day cancellations made 2+ hours before pickup are **excluded** from the numerator (they are counted as cancellations, not no-shows).
- Denominator is **all scheduled trips**, including those later cancelled.

**Completed trip.** Patient boarded and reached the clinic.

**Cancellation.** Trip called off by patient or clinic before pickup, at any notice.

> Owner: Access Analytics. Last reviewed this quarter.

confluence_pages.title: Regional Ops Dashboard — Spec v2
confluence_pages.body:
# Regional Ops Dashboard — Spec v2

The dashboard surfaces transport reliability for regional clinic managers.

## Tile: No-Show Rate

We compute the **no-show rate** as no-shows divided by *completed-or-no-show* trips. Cancellations are removed from the denominator entirely so managers see reliability among trips that were actually 'live' at pickup time.

`no_show_rate = no_shows / (completed_trips + no_shows)`

Also note: for this tile, **any same-day cancellation** (regardless of notice) is rolled into no-shows, because from the driver's route perspective a late same-day cancel behaves like a no-show.

> This is the number shown to regional managers in the weekly reliability review.

confluence_pages.title: 2024 No-Show Baseline Analysis
confluence_pages.body:
# 2024 Baseline Analysis

Baseline transport no-show rate across regional clinics: **18.4%** (per the Glossary definition). Range 11%–27% by site.

Top associated factors (correlational, not causal): trips scheduled >7 days out, no confirmed contact number on file, first-time transport users, and pickup windows before 8am.

Note: an earlier version of this analysis reported **24%** — that figure used the Ops Dashboard definition, which removes cancellations from the denominator and folds same-day cancels into no-shows. The two numbers are not comparable. Pick one definition before setting the target.

confluence_pages.title: Pilot A — Automated SMS Reminders (results)
confluence_pages.body:
# Pilot A — Automated SMS Reminders

**Design.** 6 weeks, 2 clinics, automated SMS at T-24h and T-2h. Control group received no SMS.

**Result.** No-show rate moved from 17.9% to 16.8% in the treatment arm — a ~6% relative reduction, **not statistically significant** at the pilot's sample size. Opt-out rate 4%. ~22% of numbers on file were invalid or landlines (SMS undeliverable).

**Read.** SMS alone underperformed the 30% target badly. The invalid-number problem caps SMS reach. See the closed spike for the recommendation this fed into.

confluence_pages.title: Pilot B — Live Caller Confirmation (results)
confluence_pages.body:
# Pilot B — Live Caller Confirmation

**Design.** 6 weeks, 2 clinics, staff called each patient at T-24h to confirm and re-book if needed.

**Result.** No-show rate 18.1% → 12.3% — a ~32% relative reduction, significant. Cost: ~7 staff-minutes per trip. Reached 61% of patients live; voicemail for the rest.

**Read.** Live contact cleared the target but is labor-intensive. Hybrid (auto-reminder + live call only for unconfirmed/high-risk) is the obvious next design.

confluence_pages.title: Rideshare Fallback — Vendor Evaluation
confluence_pages.body:
# Rideshare Fallback Evaluation

Evaluated two rideshare APIs for same-day gap coverage when a contracted NEMT trip falls through.

- Coverage good in metro-adjacent regions, thin in rural sites (>25 min ETA).
- Wheelchair-accessible vehicle availability is the binding constraint; both vendors under-supply it.
- Cost per completed trip competitive vs. NEMT for short urban trips only.

**Read.** Useful as a fallback for ambulatory patients in denser regions; not a primary channel and not a fix for the accessibility segment.

confluence_pages.title: Literature & Prior-Art Scan — No-Show Drivers
confluence_pages.body:
# Prior-Art Scan

Summary of external and internal prior findings on missed medical transport:

- Reminders help most when they enable *action* (easy reschedule/confirm), not just notification.
- Single-channel reminders plateau quickly; multi-touch and live contact outperform.
- Data quality (valid phone numbers) is a common hidden ceiling on any messaging approach.
- Transportation *availability* (accessible vehicles, rural ETA) is a distinct problem from *reminders* and needs its own track.

**Implication.** Treating no-shows as purely a reminder problem under-scopes it.

confluence_pages.title: EPIC BRIEF — Automated SMS Reminder Rollout (active)
confluence_pages.body:
# Epic Brief — Automated SMS Reminder Rollout

**Status: ACTIVE / committed for this quarter.**

**Assumption.** Automated SMS reminders are the primary lever to hit the 30% no-show reduction target. Plan: roll SMS reminders to all regional clinics, no live-caller component.

**Assumed impact.** 25–30% relative reduction in no-show rate from SMS alone.

**Open dependency.** Requires valid mobile numbers on file (assumed ~95% coverage).

> NOTE FOR REVIEWERS: this epic's core assumption conflicts with Pilot A results and the closed spike BP2 below. Reconcile before build.

confluence_pages.title: Spike Write-up — SMS-Only Reminder Approach (CLOSED, Won't Do)
confluence_pages.body:
# Spike Write-up — Is SMS-Only Sufficient? (CLOSED — Won't Do)

Mirror of Jira spike **BP2** (resolution: Won't Do).

**Question.** Can an SMS-only reminder program deliver the 30% no-show reduction target?

**Findings.** No. Pilot A showed ~6% relative reduction (not significant), capped by ~22% invalid/landline numbers. Target requires live or hybrid contact (Pilot B: ~32%).

**Recommendation.** Do NOT pursue SMS-only. Adopt a hybrid: automated reminder + live confirmation for unconfirmed/high-risk trips, and fix phone-number data quality first.

**Decision.** Spike closed Won't Do. Any epic assuming SMS-only should be re-scoped.

confluence_pages.title: Patient Segments & Access Barriers
confluence_pages.body:
# Patient Segments & Barriers

- **Ambulatory, metro-adjacent:** reminders + rideshare fallback work well.
- **Wheelchair/accessibility-dependent:** blocked by accessible-vehicle supply, not reminders.
- **Rural:** long ETAs; scheduling density is the lever.
- **Low data-quality contacts:** no valid mobile — unreachable by SMS; need address/landline outreach.

Segment mix varies widely by site; a single channel will not serve all four.

confluence_pages.title: Scheduling System Constraints
confluence_pages.body:
# Scheduling System Constraints

- Transport booking lives in a separate system from clinical scheduling; sync lag up to 30 min.
- Phone number field is free-text and not validated at entry — root cause of the invalid-number ceiling.
- No native hook for T-2h automated messaging; requires middleware.
- Same-day re-booking is manual.

These constraints bound how well ANY reminder channel can perform until data entry is fixed.

confluence_pages.title: Stakeholders & Owners
confluence_pages.body:
# Stakeholders & Owners

- **VP Clinic Operations** — sponsor, target owner.
- **Regional Access squad** — product owner, delivery.
- **Access Analytics** — metric definitions, measurement (owns the Glossary).
- **NEMT vendor management** — contracts, accessible-vehicle supply.
- **Clinic managers** — consume the Ops Dashboard weekly.

Note: Analytics owns the Glossary definition; the Dashboard team maintains a different one. Not yet reconciled.

confluence_pages.title: Decision Log
confluence_pages.body:
# Decision Log

1. Target set at 30% relative reduction in transport no-show rate (definition: TBD — Glossary vs Dashboard unresolved).
2. Pilot A (SMS) and Pilot B (live caller) run. Pilot B hit target; Pilot A did not.
3. Spike BP2 closed Won't Do: SMS-only insufficient; hybrid recommended.
4. OPEN: 'Automated SMS Reminder Rollout' epic still active despite (2) and (3). Needs reconciliation.
5. OPEN: pick ONE no-show-rate definition before reporting progress.

jira_issues.summary: SPIKE: Is an SMS-only reminder program sufficient to hit the 30% no-show target?
jira_issues.description: Investigate whether SMS-only reminders can achieve the 30% reduction. FINDING: No — Pilot A ~6% (n.s.), capped by ~22% invalid/landline numbers; Pilot B live-caller ~32%. RECOMMENDATION: do NOT pursue SMS-only; adopt hybrid (auto + live confirmation for unconfirmed/high-risk) and fix phone-number data quality first. Resolution: Won't Do.

jira_issues.summary: Validate mobile phone numbers at transport booking entry
jira_issues.description: Add validation to the free-text phone field; root cause of the ~22% SMS-undeliverable ceiling.

jira_issues.summary: Design hybrid reminder flow (auto reminder + live confirmation for high-risk trips)
jira_issues.description: Per Pilot B and spike recommendation: automated reminder for all, live call only for unconfirmed/high-risk. Target 30% reduction at lower labor cost than all-live.

jira_issues.summary: Reconcile the two no-show-rate definitions (Glossary vs Ops Dashboard)
jira_issues.description: Glossary: no_shows/scheduled_trips, excluding 2h+ cancels. Dashboard: no_shows/(completed+no_shows), folding same-day cancels into no-shows. Pick one before reporting target progress.
